title: ShiftSegment - Data API
description: Represents a scheduled activity within a shift. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

EndTime.description: The date and time when the shift segment ends.

IsInAdherence.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsInAdherence.description: Indicates whether the agent is in adherence (true) or not (false) for the scheduled segment activity. The default value is true.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the shift segment.

SegmentTypeId.description: The unique ID of the associated shift segment type. This is a relationship field.

ShiftId.description: The unique ID of the shift in which the segment is scheduled. This is a relationship field.

StartTime.description: The date and time when the shift segment starts.
